categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Chinastars New Materials Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, design, production, and sales of reflective materials and related products, including reflective fabrics, reflective clothing, reflective tapes, and other reflective items. The company focuses on reflective fabrics used in occupational safety, personal safety, and expanding into consumer and outdoor sports markets. It also develops functional reflective fabrics with enhanced comfort and fashion elements.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes coating and composite technologies to embed high refractive index glass beads onto substrate surfaces, creating functional composite reflective materials. It continuously improves product performance and manufacturing processes, including water-based acrylic adhesives, solvent-free adhesives, vacuum coating, and high-performance pressure-sensitive adhesives. The company holds over 200 patents, including invention patents in China, the US, and Europe, and operates a market-oriented R&D center collaborating with universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include occupational safety sectors such as traffic police, sanitation, firefighting, construction, mining, petrochemical, airports, and delivery services. The company also serves the personal safety market, including school uniforms, automotive safety vests, and outdoor sports equipment. Major end markets are domestic and international brands in safety apparel, fashion, outdoor sports, and camping gear industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Zhejiang Province (Jingjiang Town and Changxing County). It exports products to Europe, the United States, Canada, Australia, and other countries. Domestic sales account for approximately 80% of revenue, with stable export sales making up about 20%.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Chinastars operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying reflective materials and functional fabrics to downstream apparel, safety equipment, and outdoor product manufacturers. It also engages in upstream activities by producing adhesives and raw materials for its products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in environmentally friendly, recyclable, and high-performance reflective materials. Key R&D directions include developing water-based and solvent-free adhesives, high-durability reflective films, multifunctional flame-retardant reflective materials, antibacterial fabrics, and novel printing technologies. It aims to expand the reflective fabric industry into consumer and fashion markets, enhancing product comfort, aesthetics, and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of reflective materials, reflective clothing, and other reflective products. The company operates a direct sales model, serving both domestic and international customers. It also gains income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the reflective fabric segment with a comprehensive product portfolio covering high-end to low-end products. It holds a leading market share in China and has strong international competitiveness supported by certifications such as CE, SGS, UL, GRS, REACH, ROHS, and OEKO-TEX. It leverages technological innovation and scale advantages to maintain its industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 792.4 million, a 13.59% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 148.1 million, up 51.93%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.89 billion, with steady growth in revenue and profitability. It maintains a strong cash flow position and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Chinastars differentiates itself by offering high-quality, durable, and environmentally friendly reflective materials that combine excellent reflectivity with fabric comfort and fashion appeal. Its products meet stringent safety standards and certifications, supporting occupational and personal safety. The company’s innovation in functional reflective fabrics, including colorful, printed, and antibacterial options, positions it as a pioneer expanding reflective materials into consumer and outdoor markets.
